desc: Establish the set interpretation: type-1 operations contribute intervals, type-2 operations contribute complements, and operation order is irrelevant.
Handle zero type-2 operations via minimum interval cover of \([1,N]\).
Handle exactly one type-2 operation via minimum interval cover of its interval excluding that operation.
Prove that an optimal solution needs at most two type-2 operations.
Run exhaustive validation against brute force using feasibility, final coverage, reported cost, and optimality rather than exact sample-output equality.
Validate and repair prefix-maximum ownership regions and one-forbidden replacement-path reconstruction.
Verify the two-type-2 candidate logic, including disjoint intervals and mixed cost-3 constructions.
Verify edge cases, complexity, memory use, and output formatting under \(N\le 10^6,\ M\le 2\cdot10^5\).
